gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kr: Paprika spreads its letters wide and lets the lowercase fill the line like capitals, loud and expressive. Noto Sans KR is the quieter one, with generous curves and a big x-height that keep the text easy going.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao reads modern and open, its tall x-height lifting the lowercase well above the usual. Paprika does the shouting with scattered, commanding letters, and the body font simply gets on with being clear.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Words in Noto Sans Lao Looped settle into solid blocks rather than jagged skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Noto Sans Lao Looped against Paprika's hollow-reed counters gives the pair its real hook: a loud display face beside a text face that stays composed.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Big, brassy and cast-iron sturdy: Paprika's lowercase fills the line, while Noto Sans Lepcha keeps its curves wide open beneath it. Loud meets approachable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and lets the lowercase swell to capital size, with counters that breathe like a cut reed. Noto Sans Limbu follows with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu is tidy, with tiny gaps under its ascender tops and a wide s. Paprika sits above it with commanding, far-flung letters, so the heading gets the swagger and the text gets quiet order.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Loud letters, hushed text: Paprika fills the line with capital-sized lowercase and hollow-reed counters. Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase, so shrinking the heading would drain Paprika of its force.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals, each letter scattered at a distance, commanding and expressive. Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall against its capitals, with a funnel-wide e.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Big, bold, and widely spaced: that is Paprika, with counters like a cut reed. Noto Sans Malayalam handles the steady work, its dominant middle zone and generous s keeping lines easy to follow.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic reads loose and curvy, its lowercase rising close to the capitals as if unclamped. And Paprika is the showman, scattering expressive letters wide while the body font simply carries the text.
